0022600197.text: The Pistons (6-2, first in the Central and third in the East) host the Lakers (7-2, first in the Pacific and second in the West), with Los Angeles arriving on a three-game winning streak and Detroit coming off a loss. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (out, hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Pistons won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 113-110 win in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
